about: Ability floors from the capability inventory. A floor is missing when no working tool does that job, and part when a tool does only some of it. Old site floor ids stay in alias.

floors.name: edit a video
floors.why: People want a clip trimmed, captioned or saved as a file they can send.
floors.prove: A stranger asks "trim the first 3 seconds off this video and add the caption hello". It counts when a tool does that job and hands back the result.
floors.ask: trim the first 3 seconds off this video and add the caption hello

floors.name: translate a live conversation
floors.why: People want speech in one language to come back in another while the talk is still going.
floors.prove: A stranger asks "translate what I say into Spanish as I speak". It counts when a tool does that job and hands back the result.
floors.ask: translate what I say into Spanish as I speak

floors.name: plan a week of meals
floors.why: People want seven dinners from the food they already have, not one recipe.
floors.prove: A stranger asks "plan a week of meals for two people from eggs, rice and beans". It counts when a tool does that job and hands back the result.
floors.ask: plan a week of meals for two people from eggs, rice and beans
